arguments.command:
cd /app/tmp/work && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import json, random, sys, resource, subprocess, time
sys.path.insert(0,"/app/tmp/work")
import genmaxp
rng=random.Random(9)
req=genmaxp.gen_request(rng)
for c in req["commodities"]: c["demand"]=1024
data=(json.dumps(req)+"\n").encode()
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/app/submission/planner.py'],input=data,capture_output=True)
print('rc',p.returncode,'time %.2fs'%(time.time()-t0))
print('max RSS of child: %.1f MiB'%(resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss/1024))
PYEOF
